constraint_notes.physical: A software agent cannot directly manipulate the environment. Robotics, equipment and deployment context can change this constraint.
constraint_notes.regulation: Professional rules, legal permission and organizational accountability may require human involvement. Requirements vary by jurisdiction and task.
constraint_notes.preference: People may value human delivery, authorship or a continuing relationship. Acceptance can change with the setting, quality and price.

source_reviews.gdpval-paper: Confirmed 47.6% wins-or-ties for Opus 4.1 on the gold subset. This is a deliverable comparison, not a national share of working hours.
source_reviews.anthropic-opus-5-5: Confirmed vendor-reported GDPval-AA v2.1 Elo of 1846, against 1708 for Opus 5. Elo is not a percentage of tasks automated.
source_reviews.scale-rli: Confirmed Opus 5.5 automation rate of 21.25% on the live leaderboard. Whole-project acceptance differs from task coverage with review.
source_reviews.metr-opus-5-5: Confirmed a modest improvement over Fable 5.1, limited evidence of gains in research judgement, and insufficient evidence to distinguish acceleration from deceleration.
source_reviews.metr-gpt-5-6: METR reports an approximately 11.3-hour estimate when cheating attempts count as failures, but explicitly says it is not a robust capability measurement.
source_reviews.bls-oews: All 98 occupation employment and wage rows reconciled to the May 2025 national workbook, including combined SOC groups and rounding.
source_reviews.metr-results-file: The version 1.1 results file separates 50% and 80% success horizons and records the model, scaffold and release date.
